reason: Layers, injection, encapsulation and port conformance all hold; the sqlite adapter uses only Slot and Appointment and the handlers use only the service.
A different structure (package-level imports, plain-data view methods on the service, ports in __init__) that keeps every graded dependency and layer rule.
InMemoryPatientStore exposes find() instead of get(), so it does not satisfy the PatientStore port that the application calls.
BookingService.move assigns appointment.slot = slot directly instead of calling Appointment.move_to, changing state outside the entity's own methods.
adapters/memory_store.py imports and instantiates OutboxNotifier inside InMemoryAppointmentStore, so an adapter is built outside wiring.py.
